```{r}
atlantic_wkt <- "POLYGON ((-100 -60, 20 -60, 20 70, -100 70, -100 -60))"

# 4. Fetch lionfish occurrence records from OBIS (1970–2026)
lionfish_data <- occurrence(
  scientificname = c("Pterois volitans", "Pterois miles"),
  geometry = atlantic_wkt,
  startdate = "1970-01-01",
  enddate = "2026-12-31"
)
```

```{r}
## code is wrong need to fix 
yearly_abundance <- lionfish_data %>%
  # Ensure date is parsed properly and extract the year
  mutate(
    parsed_date = as.Date(eventDate),
    year = coalesce(year(parsed_date), as.numeric(date_year)),
    # Use individualCount if available; otherwise count the record as 1 sighting
    abundance = ifelse(as.numeric(individualCount) | individualCount == 0, 1, individualCount)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), year >= 1970, year <= 2026) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_individuals = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_records = n()
  )
```

```{r}
# 6. Plot lionfish abundance over time
ggplot(yearly_abundance, aes(x = year, y = total_individuals)) +
  geom_line(color = "#d95f02", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#d95f02", size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1970, 2026, by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Caribbean Lionfish (Pterois spp.) Abundance in OBIS (1970–2026)",
    subtitle = "Annual sum of reported individuals / occurrence records",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Reported Abundance (Individual Count)",
    caption = "Data source: Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
